I originally installed LangGraph because everyone kept calling it “the future of AI agents.” Honestly, I was skeptical. I’d already built chatbots using simple prompts, and they worked well enough. But after building my first multi-agent workflow with LangGraph, I realized I had been thinking about AI all wrong. The real breakthrough wasn’t creating smarter prompts it was designing smarter systems.

5 min read
Just now

Photo by Faizi Sheikh on Unsplash1. My AI Apps Worked Until They Needed More Than One Step
My first AI applications were surprisingly simple.
A user entered a prompt.
The model generated a response.
The application displayed it.
Done.
It worked beautifully.
Until clients started asking for things like:

• Research a topic

• Verify the information

• Generate a report
